Qualification runtime: Open Object Rexx 5.3.0 r13196 Internal Test Version (build 2026-08-03).

PASS Native database capability model
  - priority selects PostgreSQL Foreign Runtime primary
  - capability requirement can select a lower-priority fallback
  - absent capability is UNKNOWN, not silently UNSUPPORTED

PASS PostgreSQL native offline
  - Foreign Runtime v0.22.2 loads libpq
  - PQlibVersion = 170010 on qualification host
  - capability and limitation publication available before session acquisition
  - deterministic connection failure produces evidence and no fabricated result

PASS PostgreSQL Database Core adapter
  - PostgreSQLNativeCommandExecutor satisfies DatabaseCommandExecutor contract
  - current PostgreSQLEngine remains the SQL/transaction compiler
  - failed native connection maps through Database Core as CONNECTIONFAILED
  - NoSQL/data semantics are not copied into this package

PASS PostgreSQL process fallback contract
  - uses existing DatabaseProcessCommandExecutor
  - explicitly separate implementation identity and limitations
  - psql was not installed on qualification host; live process fallback was not executed

PASS GeoPackage ooRexx portable backend
  - uses NoSQLServer v0.79 GeoPackageDatabaseEngine by package reference
  - direct pure-ooRexx binary reader discovers 3 tables in bundled fixture
  - SELECT sample_address LIMIT 2 returns 2 rows
  - accessPath = GEOPACKAGE_NATIVE_SQLITE_SCAN
  - mutation is explicitly UNSUPPORTED
  - FOREIGN_ACCELERATION is CONDITIONAL, not required

Design acceptance:
  - backend selection occurs before acquisition
  - NativeDatabaseBackendLease pins implementation identity
  - no mid-session / mid-transaction replay through a fallback
  - capabilities, limitations, requirements, implementation kind and qualification status are machine-readable
  - pure ooRexx GIS remains the portable no-external-library baseline; Foreign Runtime acceleration is additive
